m5_context.statement: Trailing-window liquidity baseline lagged breakout-day liquidity and acted as sole veto on at least one high-volume Set A day.

early_tier_notes.value_thesis: Catch accumulation stage, not only confirmed breakouts.

final_probe_note.design_response: Advance references during confirmed accumulation and require full telemetry for any retained blocking layer.

finding_response_map.EARLY_TIER: Structural answer to the pre-volume edge: expose accumulation-stage entries using flow confirmation and adaptive base validity before breakout confirmation. Anchors: FlowConfirmationEngine AdaptiveBaseGeometry EARLY_ACCUMULATION_ENTRY EARLY_ENTRY_FLOW_OK EARLY_ENTRY_BASE_VALID_OK.
finding_response_map.F1: Solved at confirmation tier; early tier intentionally bypasses same-day volume multiple dependence when flow confirmation and base validity are present. Anchors: FlowConfirmationEngine CONFIRM_FLOW_CORE_OK BASE_REFERENCE_VALID.
finding_response_map.F2: Solved by AdaptiveBaseGeometry replacing fixed-width geometry with regime-aware geometry.
finding_response_map.F3: Addressed by LifecycleIntentRouter and persistent base references; to be validated in R15.
finding_response_map.F4: Solved by WarmupReadinessEngine with explicit readiness states and fallback.
finding_response_map.F5: Preserved by AvoidAuthorityPlane retaining avoid veto semantics.
finding_response_map.F6: Explained by moving emphasis from veto gates to candidate-intent and confirmation persistence. Anchors: LifecycleIntentRouter DEFERRED_INTENT_ACTIVE DEFERRED_INTENT.
finding_response_map.F7: Solved by PredicateTelemetryLedger persisting every term every day.
finding_response_map.F8: Tested by combining adaptive base geometry with persistent base references and deferred intent. Anchors: AdaptiveBaseGeometry BASE_REFERENCE_PRESENT BASE_REFERENCE_VALID DEFERRED_INTENT_ACTIVE.
finding_response_map.F8a: Solved by persistent base references plus readiness-aware base freeze so missing-reference disarm cannot persist silently. Anchors: AdaptiveBaseGeometry BASE_REFERENCE_PRESENT READINESS_FALLBACK_ELIGIBLE.
finding_response_map.F8b: Solved by advancing current-valid references during confirmed accumulation and referencing chase guard to the current valid reference, not the original freeze. Anchors: LifecycleIntentRouter BASE_REFERENCE_ADVANCE_OK CHASE_GUARD_CURRENT_REF_OK.
finding_response_map.F8c: Not established by sealed evidence; however, any remaining veto-capable post-mandatory authority must be fully telemetried as named predicates if retained. Anchors: PredicateTelemetryLedger daily_term_row predicate_name predicate_pass.
finding_response_map.F9: Solved at confirmation tier; early tier uses current and arriving liquidity as participation context, not as a sole veto, while preserving optional participation caps. Anchors: ExecutionLiquidityAssessment CURRENT_DAY_LIQUIDITY_OK LIQUIDITY_CONTEXT_OK CONFIRM_LIQUIDITY_OK.

module_boundaries.responsibility: Provide day-normalized input payloads and segment-aware readiness context.
Determine readiness state, warmup fallback, and reset semantics for new listings and segment restarts.
Detect, freeze, ratchet, invalidate, and retire bases using regime-aware geometry.
Score confirmation using accumulation-window flow evidence plus breakout structure.
Persist candidate intent, survive delayed volume arrival, and hand off to risk/capacity layer.
Retain current avoid authority semantics as a veto plane on top of the architecture.
Persist every predicate term, every day, for every symbol.
Evaluate current-day and context liquidity sufficiency, emit CURRENT_DAY_LIQUIDITY_OK and LIQUIDITY_CONTEXT_OK terms, and enforce liquidity gating semantics.
